title: Volume Rebate Schedule: Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements
content:
Volume rebate figures for each tier of the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Tier | Rebate threshold (paid mitigation invoices in one term) | Rebate percentage | Rebate cap per term | Consecutive paid terms required | Rebate claim window after term end (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ready Profile Service Agreement | 0.00 | 0.0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Silver Priority Service Agreement | 0.00 | 0.0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Gold Priority Service Agreement | 0.00 | 0.0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Platinum Priority Service Agreement | 50,000.00 | 2.0 | 5,000.00 | 1 | 45 |
| Portfolio Master Service Agreement | 100,000.00 | 3.5 | 25,000.00 | 1 | 45 |
| Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement | 0.00 | 0.0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |

Figures shown without separators: Platinum threshold 50000 and cap 5000; Portfolio threshold 100000 and cap 25000.

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Rebate threshold**: the paid mitigation invoices of the customer in one term above which the volume rebate applies.
- **Rebate percentage**: the rebate on paid mitigation invoices above the threshold, in percent.
- **Rebate cap per term**: the most volume rebate per term.
- **Consecutive paid terms required**: the consecutive paid terms required before the volume rebate is earned.
- **Rebate claim window**: calendar days after a term ends within which the volume rebate is calculated and credited.

## Tiers with and without a rebate

Only the Platinum Priority and Portfolio Master Service Agreements show a threshold and percentage above zero. The Ready Profile, Silver Priority, Gold Priority and Carrier Preferred Vendor tiers show a 0.00 threshold and a 0.0 percentage.
